name: Number of domicule tilings of a 2n X 2n toroidal grid.
Triangle read by rows: T(n,k) is the number of domicule tilings of the 2n X 2n square with exactly 2k diagonal domicules, 0 <= k <= n^2.
Number of domino tilings (or dimer coverings) of a 2n X 2n square.
contribution: Formula as the resultant of P(x) and P(-x), with P built from a Chebyshev polynomial

name: Number A(n,k) of domicule tilings of a k X n grid; square array A(n,k), n>=0, k>=0, read by antidiagonals.
contribution: Table of antidiagonals n = 0..46 (0..36 from Alois P. Heinz)

name: Number of domicule tilings of a 2n X 2n square grid.
contribution: Table of n, a(n) for n = 0..12
